753:t_025:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「We'll forge a path to the future!」

753:t_026:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Thank you, $$マリーダ$$! I'll use the power you've guided to us!」

753:t_026:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$! Now we'll become one!」

753:t_027:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$... Do you believe in the future too?」

753:t_027:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$ララァ$$... I can see time too...」

753:t_027:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What is this power...?! It isn't just Earth's $$次元力|lc$$! Is this... human will...?!」

753:t_027:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Now we have power equal to yours!」

753:t_027:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Impossible! The $$御使い$$s are the unified lives of $$エス・テラン$$, and I have united even them into one!」

753:t_027:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「The hopes of everyone on Earth are flowing into us now!」

753:t_027:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「And now those hopes are becoming one! Through our bodies!」

753:t_027:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To accept others and live together... Have all Earth's people finally reached the truth?!」

753:t_028:2.en:
$$不動$$
「They no longer need a guide.」

753:t_028:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That old man! He's butting in again!」

753:t_028:5.en:
$$不動$$
「This truly is our farewell. You will finally leave me... no, the bonds of higher-dimensional beings behind completely.」

753:t_028:6.en:
$$不動$$
「Go forth with love, courage and hope.」

753:t_029:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It seems he too has come to witness the outcome of the battle.」

753:t_029:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...At last... a species that has reached the truth... is emerging...」

753:t_029:4.en:
$n
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Don't think you're the only special one!」

753:t_029:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're fighting with the united hopes of Earth's... no, of every living being!」

753:t_029:6.en:
$n
「Even your divine power can't break our hearts!」

753:t_029:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well. I shall acknowledge you anew.」

753:t_029:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Though you have only minutes left, I bless Earth's people for attaining the truth.」

753:t_029:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Even now, he's still acting like he's got nothing to worry about?!」

753:t_029:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am immortal. As long as that remains true, my victory is assured.」

753:t_029:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like we weren't the only ones who got power from Earth's encouragement.」

753:t_029:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What are you talking about?」

753:t_029:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Let your hopes join ours too!」

753:t_030:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The power of infinite lives has called me back from my nightmare.」

753:t_030:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$! What can you possibly do now?!」

753:t_030:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I don't think I could possibly steal your vaunted Supreme God...」

753:t_030:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... This monster, with all the $$スフィア$$s' power, seems capable of granting my one and only wish.」

753:t_030:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Absurd! Would you abandon eternity of your own free will?!」

753:t_030:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You sought to become God... to become eternal. You wouldn't understand.」

753:t_030:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I... have lived until this day for that alone.」

753:t_031:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Why?! Why is $$至高神Ｚ$$ trying to grant $$アサキム$$'s wish?!」

753:t_031:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You have abandoned the meaning of life. You cannot become one with $$太極$$... with the Supreme God.」

753:t_031:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The meaning of $$太極$$... In other words, it is... life...」

753:t_031:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My wish has reached it... All that remains is...」

753:t_031:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leave it to us, $$アサキム$$! We've received your wish!」

753:t_031:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「To bring an end to everything, we'll grant your wish with our own hands!」

753:t_031:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't think mere Earthlings can defeat me!」

753:t_031:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I have surpassed even the $$御使い$$s! Only I can survive the universe's great collapse!」

753:t_031:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For the first time, you've shown anger from the bottom of your heart.」

753:t_031:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A man who calls himself God has surrendered to his passions.」

753:t_031:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Is this... the emotion of $$ドクトリン$$, whom I absorbed...?!」

753:t_031:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「You thought you'd surpassed humanity, surpassed the $$御使い$$s and finally become God!」

753:t_031:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you raged at $$ドクトリン$$ for banishing you, mourned your plight, found joy in becoming God and reveled in its power!」

753:t_031:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're doing exactly what humans do, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_031:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We can't lose to someone who's neither immortal nor a god!」

753:t_031:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「From here on, it's a fair fight!」

753:t_031:19.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I... am God! I alone can save this universe!」

753:t_031:20.en:
$$レド$$
「Humans aren't gods, and they don't need to become gods!」

753:t_031:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you'd lived alongside us, I'm sure there could have been another path!」

753:t_031:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But you drowned in your power and lost your way!」

753:t_031:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「A guy like that is no god! He's just a villain!」

753:t_031:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you use that power to block the future, I'll overcome you!」

753:t_031:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Mere humans have no right to deny me!」

753:t_031:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That arrogance is what brings war to the universe!」
